title: Marathon Split Pace Personal Best Detection
dataSources: Race results (`raceresult:event`), TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), marathon splits (`race:split`), bib pickup and race logistics (`race:bib`).
app: Race result APIs, TrainingPeaks workouts and TSS, marathon split exports, and bib-collection checklists streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted REST inputs, CSV imports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=race:split
| sort 0 _time
| streamstats min(split_pace_min) as prior_best current=f
| where isnotnull(prior_best) AND split_pace_min<prior_best
| table _time checkpoint split_pace_min prior_best
description: Scans your marathon split pace history in time order and highlights any entry that set a new personal best using the lower metric direction.
value: Automatic personal-best detection turns long history tables into a clean milestone log that is motivating and easy to review.
implementation: Keep the underlying metric normalized across sessions so the best-detection logic compares like events with like events.
visualization: Table of personal-best events with the previous best beside the new value.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals the moments when marathon split pace reached a new best for you.
